text: Good evening madam, I am the grandmother of Aarav, 18 months old. His fever is 38.3 only, I checked two times, but his hands and feet are ice cold and he is shivering like anything, full body shaking under two blankets. Fever is there but body is cold, how this is possible? His parents are out of station and I am alone with him since morning, totally tired now. Kindly tell what to do.
